summary: Round r1 (restricted network). Leads reuse upstream Agent 23 sources (MoLESS Labour Migration Report 2024, DoFE yearly reports, Census 2021 migration materials, OECD IMO 2025, destination student-visa and skilled-route policy texts, IOM MGI 2024) and add general-knowledge (unverified) leads for OECD DIOC, UIS outbound students, MoEST study-abroad NOCs, NLFS return module, CTEVT/NSTB RPL and World Bank EVENT evaluations. No values retrieved; all empirical items pending. Key points: DoFE skill categories describe jobs not certified skills; high-skill emigration has stock, flow and intention measures that are not interchangeable; no evaluated knowledge-transfer programme has been retrieved yet.

findings.claim: Q1: Labour approvals by skill level (skilled / semi-skilled / unskilled) and by occupation, FY2022/23-FY2025/26.
findings.note: Required: MoLESS Labour Migration Report 2024 skill tables (09C-L01); DoFE yearly reports (09C-L02). Skill level is declared at approval and reflects the job offered, not certified competence.

findings.claim: Q1: Share of returnee migrants reporting skills/training acquired abroad, and share whose skills are certified (RPL/skill test) after return.
findings.note: Required: NLFS return-migrant module (09C-L14); NSTB/CTEVT RPL counts (09C-L15); IOM MGI assessment (09C-L12). No Nepal survey with a skills-acquired-abroad question is yet confirmed.

findings.claim: Q1: Returnee employment outcomes - occupation and sector on return relative to occupation abroad.
Q2: Tertiary-educated emigration rate (share of Nepal-born tertiary-educated population living in OECD countries).
Q2: Outbound internationally mobile tertiary students from Nepal, by destination; outbound mobility ratio.
Q2: MoEST No Objection Letters issued for foreign study, by destination and FY.
findings.note: Required: MoEST NOC statistics (09C-L07). NOCs are not departures; keep separate from UIS and destination visa data.

findings.claim: Q2: Destination-side student visa grants and inflows of Nepali nationals (Australia, Canada, UK, Japan, OECD total).
findings.note: Required: OECD IMO 2025 annex (09C-L04); Home Affairs (09C-L08); IRCC (09C-L09); UK and Japan sources (09C-L10, L11).

findings.claim: Q2: Absent population abroad for study and for work, by education level (Census 2021).
findings.note: Required: Census 2021 migration thematic report/tables (09C-L03). Includes India; complements DoFE flow data (23A challenge).

findings.claim: Q2: Emigration of health professionals (doctors, nurses) from Nepal.
findings.note: Required: OECD IMO 2025 health-migration chapter (09C-L04); Nepal Nursing Council / Nepal Medical Council verification-letter counts (no URL located).

findings.claim: Q3: Knowledge-transfer and return/reintegration programmes with published evaluations (design, outcome measured, effect, evaluation method).
findings.note: Required: World Bank EVENT ICRs/impact evaluations (09C-L16); IOM MGI (09C-L12); any evaluated NRN knowledge-transfer or returnee-entrepreneurship programme. No evaluation retrieved yet; programmes without an evaluation will be listed as 'unevaluated', not scored.

findings.claim: DoFE skill classification (skilled/semi-skilled/unskilled) describes the destination job category and is not a measure of certified qualifications.
findings.note: Definition caution for interpreting labour-permit skill composition.

findings.claim: High-skill emigration is measured by at least three non-equivalent series (stock-based DIOC, flow-based student/visa counts, intention-based NOCs); none is used as a substitute for another.
findings.note: Measurement design; conflicts will be recorded via find_conflicts.

data_gaps: No Nepal survey confirmed to ask returnees about skills acquired abroad and certification; required: survey module with question text and sample.
MoEST NOC statistics page not located; required: NOCs by destination and FY.
DIOC latest round for Nepal-born by education unconfirmed.
Health-professional emigration: no Nepal Nursing/Medical Council statistics located.
Evaluations of diaspora knowledge-transfer programmes: none located.

assumptions.text: DoFE skill categories are job categories, not qualifications.
Brain-drain series (stock, flow, intention) are reported separately and not converted into each other.

challenges.text: Accept 23A challenge: 09C will use Census 2021 absentee stock (includes India) for population accounting and DoFE approvals only for Gulf/Malaysia/other permit-based flows. Request 23A tabulate DoFE approvals by skill category alongside destination so 09C can reuse one extraction.
Accept 23D challenge: outward labour-supply parameters will be linked to WPP working-age projections; 09 requests 23D publish the WPP extraction by age/sex so education-cohort splits can be applied.
Any strategy claiming returnee skills raise domestic productivity should be audited against 09C skill_acquisition_evidence; no evaluated evidence has been retrieved yet.

uncertainty: High. No values retrieved. Returnee skill and certification evidence may not exist in official surveys; high-skill emigration measures differ in concept and coverage; several URLs are from general knowledge and unverified. Student-visa policy changes in 2025-2026 (Canada cap, UK, Australia) make recent flows non-representative of trend.
